title: Doorbell counted thirteen kids. I gave candy to twelve 🎃
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, bright porch light, clear subject, sharp focus, high contrast, 35mm film grain, realistic, suburban American home at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: On Halloween, my doorbell camera counted thirteen trick-or-treaters. I gave candy to twelve.

scenes.narration: On Halloween, my doorbell camera counted thirteen trick-or-treaters. I gave candy to twelve.

shots.prompt: suburban front door at night, bright warm porch light, carved pumpkin glowing, bowl of candy on the step, doorbell camera angle, no person

scenes.narration: I always count them. Witches. A ghost. Two tiny astronauts. Twelve kids. Twelve thank-yous.

shots.prompt: group of small children in halloween costumes seen from behind on a lit porch steps at night, witch hat, white ghost sheet, astronaut helmets, no faces

scenes.narration: At ten, I rewound the doorbell video. Thirteen figures on my steps. Twelve took candy. One stood at the very back, arms at its sides. It never moved.

shots.prompt: security camera view of a lit porch at night, small children in costumes, one very tall thin figure in a long gray coat at the back, hood up, face hidden in shadow

scenes.narration: It wore a gray coat. My gray coat. The torn pocket. The keys on the belt.

shots.prompt: long gray coat with a torn pocket and a ring of keys on the belt, bright porch light, no head visible

scenes.narration: Then I watched the door. It opened. A gray sleeve handed out the candy. Twelve times. Same sleeve. Same coat.

shots.prompt: open front door at night with a gray coat sleeve and hand reaching out holding a candy bowl, bright porch light, the rest of the body hidden in the dark hallway, no face

scenes.narration: But I was on the couch. All night. I remember the game. I never stood up.

shots.prompt: empty living room couch with a blanket lit by a television at night, remote on the cushion, no person

scenes.narration: Then my phone buzzed. My neighbor. Who is standing on your porch right now?

shots.prompt: phone lighting up in a dark living room next to a couch, bright screen glow, no person visible

overlays.text: Who is standing on your porch?

scenes.narration: I opened the live feed. The porch was empty. The bowl was empty too. Every candy was gone.

shots.prompt: phone screen showing a security camera live view of an empty lit porch with an empty candy bowl and a glowing pumpkin, night

scenes.narration: Then the doorbell chimed. From inside the house. And the couch cushion beside me sank, like someone had just sat down.

shots.prompt: couch cushion with a deep fresh indentation beside a blanket in a dim living room lit by a tv, no person visible, dramatic shadows

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do I look at it, or keep watching the game?

overlays.text: LOOK AT IT  or  KEEP WATCHING
